mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at partly cloudy skies with a temperature of 65 degrees, which feels like 64 degrees near Verona Area High School. Tonight we have a beautiful waxing crescent moon, though we will not have any visible space station passes.

In city news, Verona continues to promote sustainability and green living. Residents living in apartments can still participate in composting by using the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the City is boosting energy efficiency by proactively upgrading City Hall lights to LEDs and partnering with Alliant Energy to replace streetlights along East and West Verona Avenue.

Mark your calendars for several fun local events. Yoga sessions are happening at Insight Wellness on July twentieth, followed by competitive trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Lake Louie on July twenty-first. Midweek, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July twenty-second.

In police news, last Friday morning, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash at Old PB and Whalen Road. A twenty-four-year-old cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a forty-nine-year-old Verona man was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

If you are craving a sweet treat, today's Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed, but they will open at 10:00 AM, so you can head over then to grab some. Tomorrow's flavor is currently unknown.
